title: Waging, or attempting to wage war, or abetting waging of war, against the Government of India
old_text: Penalized waging war, attempting to wage war, or abetting the waging of war against the Government of India with death or life imprisonment and fine.
new_text: Penalizes anyone who wages war against the Government of India, attempts such war, or abets its waging, with death or imprisonment for life and fine.
punishment_old: Death, or imprisonment for life, and fine (IPC Section 121).
punishment_new: Death, or imprisonment for life, and fine (BNS Section 147).
explanation: Carries forward the supreme offence against state sovereignty, retaining capital punishment as an alternative to life imprisonment. Renumbered from IPC Section 121 without substantive alteration.

title: Conspiracy to commit offences punishable by section 147
old_text: Penalized conspiring to commit offences of waging war against the Government or conspiring to overawe the government by criminal force with life imprisonment or up to 10 years and fine.
new_text: Penalizes conspiring within or outside India to commit any offence punishable under section 147, or conspiring to overawe the Government of India or any State Government by means of criminal force.
punishment_old: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine (IPC Section 121A).
punishment_new: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine (BNS Section 148).
explanation: Penalizes conspiracies targeting the overthrow or coercion of Union or State Governments, with liability attaching without requiring an overt act of war. Renumbered from IPC Section 121A.

title: Collecting arms, etc., with intention of waging war against the Government of India
old_text: Penalized collecting men, arms, or ammunition, or otherwise preparing to wage war with the intention of waging war with life imprisonment or up to 10 years and fine.
new_text: Penalizes collecting men, arms, ammunition, or otherwise preparing to wage war with the intention of waging war against the Government of India.
punishment_old: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine (IPC Section 122).
punishment_new: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine (BNS Section 149).
explanation: Criminalizes logistics, stockpiling of munitions, and organizational preparation for armed revolt against India. Renumbered from IPC Section 122.

title: Concealing with intent to facilitate design to wage war
old_text: Penalized concealing by any act or omission the existence of a design to wage war against the Government with imprisonment up to 10 years and fine.
new_text: Penalizes voluntarily concealing, by act or illegal omission, the existence of a design to wage war against the Government of India with intent to facilitate such war.
punishment_old: Imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine (IPC Section 123).
punishment_new: Imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine (BNS Section 150).
explanation: Punishes covert facilitation or concealment of armed plots directed against the nation. Renumbered from IPC Section 123.

title: Assaulting President, Governor, etc., with intent to compel or restrain the exercise of any lawful power
old_text: Penalized assaulting or wrongfully restraining the President or Governor with intent to induce or compel them to exercise or refrain from exercising lawful powers with imprisonment up to 7 years and fine.
new_text: Penalizes assaulting, using criminal force, or attempting to wrongfully restrain the President of India or any Governor with intent to compel or restrain lawful executive authority.
punishment_old: Imprisonment up to 7 years, and fine (IPC Section 124).
punishment_new: Imprisonment up to 7 years, and fine (BNS Section 151).
explanation: Guarantees physical security and unhindered constitutional functioning of the heads of Union and State executive branches. Renumbered from IPC Section 124.

title: Act endangering sovereignty, unity and integrity of India
old_text: IPC Section 124A (Sedition) penalized bringing or attempting to bring into hatred or contempt, or exciting disaffection towards the Government established by law, with life imprisonment or up to 3 years and fine.
new_text: Whoever, purposely or knowingly, by words, signs, visible representations, electronic communication, or financial means, excites or attempts to excite secession, armed rebellion, or subversive activities, or encourages feelings of separatist activities, or endangers sovereignty, unity, and integrity of India, shall be punished with life imprisonment or imprisonment up to 7 years, and fine. An Explanation protects lawful criticism of government measures seeking alteration by legal means.
punishment_old: Imprisonment for life and fine, or imprisonment up to 3 years and fine (IPC Section 124A).
punishment_new: Imprisonment for life or imprisonment which may extend to seven years, and fine (BNS Section 152). TODO: Verify implementation guidelines regarding preliminary inquiries pending before judicial benches.
explanation: Replaces the colonial offence of sedition (Rajdroh) with a targeted provision focused on protecting national sovereignty and unity (Deshdroh). Removes disaffection toward the government from the operative text, adds electronic and financial vectors, and raises the determinate prison alternative from 3 to 7 years while retaining an explicit carve-out for lawful policy criticism.

title: Waging war against the Government of any foreign State at peace with the Government of India
old_text: Penalized waging war against the government of any Asiatic power in alliance or at peace with the Government of India with life imprisonment or up to 7 years and fine.
new_text: Penalizes waging war, attempting to wage war, or abetting war against the Government of any foreign State at peace with the Government of India.
punishment_old: Imprisonment for life and fine, or imprisonment up to 7 years and fine (IPC Section 125).
punishment_new: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment up to seven years, and fine (BNS Section 153).
explanation: Modernizes international comity by replacing colonial terminology ('Asiatic power') with 'any foreign State at peace with the Government of India'. Renumbered from IPC Section 125.

title: Committing depredation on territories of foreign States at peace with the Government of India
old_text: Penalized committing depredation or making preparations to commit depredation on the territories of foreign states at peace with India with imprisonment up to 7 years, fine, and forfeiture of property.
new_text: Penalizes committing depredation, or making preparations to commit depredation, on territories of any foreign State at peace with the Government of India.
punishment_old: Imprisonment up to 7 years, and fine, and forfeiture of property used (IPC Section 126).
punishment_new: Imprisonment up to seven years, and fine, and forfeiture of property used (BNS Section 154).
explanation: Penalizes private cross-border armed raids or plundering expeditions launched from India into friendly neighboring countries. Renumbered from IPC Section 126.

title: Receiving property taken by war or depredation mentioned in sections 153 and 154
old_text: Penalized receiving any property knowing it to have been taken in the commission of warfare or depredation against friendly powers with up to 7 years, fine, and forfeiture.
new_text: Penalizes receiving any property knowing the same to have been taken in the commission of warfare or depredation against friendly foreign States.
punishment_old: Imprisonment up to 7 years, and fine, and forfeiture of property (IPC Section 127).
punishment_new: Imprisonment up to seven years, and fine, and forfeiture of property (BNS Section 155).
explanation: Suppresses illegal trafficking in wartime plunder or pillaged spoils acquired during cross-border conflicts. Renumbered from IPC Section 127.

title: Public servant voluntarily allowing prisoner of State or war to escape
old_text: Penalized public servants voluntarily allowing state or war prisoners in custody to escape with life imprisonment or up to 10 years and fine.
new_text: Penalizes any public servant having custody of any prisoner of State or prisoner of war who voluntarily allows such prisoner to escape from any place of confinement.
punishment_old: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine (IPC Section 128).
punishment_new: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine (BNS Section 156).
explanation: Imposes severe sanctions upon custodial officers who intentionally facilitate the escape of sovereign prisoners of war or state detainees. Renumbered from IPC Section 128.

title: Public servant negligently suffering such prisoner to escape
old_text: Penalized public servants negligently suffering state or war prisoners to escape with simple imprisonment up to 3 years and fine.
new_text: Penalizes any public servant having custody of any prisoner of State or war who negligently suffers such prisoner to escape from place of confinement.
punishment_old: Simple imprisonment up to 3 years, and fine (IPC Section 129).
punishment_new: Simple imprisonment up to three years, and fine (BNS Section 157).
explanation: Penalizes gross custodial negligence or laxity resulting in the escape of military or state detainees. Renumbered from IPC Section 129.

title: Aiding escape of, rescuing or harbouring such prisoner
old_text: Penalized aiding the escape, rescuing, or harbouring an escaped prisoner of State or war with life imprisonment or up to 10 years and fine.
new_text: Penalizes aiding or assisting any prisoner of State or war in escaping, rescuing such prisoner, or harbouring or concealing an escaped prisoner.
punishment_old: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine (IPC Section 130).
punishment_new: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine (BNS Section 158).
explanation: Penalizes private citizens or third-party conspirators who aid, harbour, or rescue escaped prisoners of state or war. Renumbered from IPC Section 130.
